# Métricas SMART do agente AutoSeguro

> Cada métrica é **S**pecífica, **M**ensurável, **A**tingível, **R**elevante (ligada a um
> critério de avaliação do desafio) e **T**emporal (quando e como é medida).
> Os valores medidos substituem a coluna "Resultado" no README — "fiz" com número.

## 1. Métricas de engenharia (medidas no repositório)

| ID | Métrica (S) | Como medir (M) | Meta (A) | Por que importa (R) | Quando (T) | Resultado |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M-01 | Taxa real de falha e lentidão do `/quote` | `scripts/characterize_quote.py`, 200 chamadas, config padrão | Só medir (esperado ~20% 5xx, ~10% lentas) | Justifica timeout, retry e breaker com dado, não com chute | Dia 1 | **20,5% 5xx · 8,0% lentas · 71,5% ok na 1ª em < 3 s** (2026-11-25, [evidência](../evidence/quote_characterization.md)) |
| M-02 | Conversas que travam no teste de caos | `tests/chaos`, 50 conversas, FAILURE 0.6 / SLOW 0.2 / SEED fixo; trava = turno > 15 s sem resposta | **0** | Critério "não trava" | Dia 2, todo `make chaos` | _a medir_ |
| M-03 | Mensagens com R$ sem cotação `success` | `OutputValidator` + varredura do outbox no caos e no golden set | **0** | Critério "nunca inventa preço" | Dia 2, todo `make test` | _a medir_ |
| M-04 | Falhas esgotadas que viram handoff | eventos `quote_request.failed` com `handoff.opened` correspondente / total | **100%** | Lead nunca fica sem resposta | Dia 2 | _a medir_ |
| M-05 | Golden set aprovado | `tests/scenarios`, 15 cenários | **15/15** | Critério de handoff explícito e defensável | Dia 3 | _a medir_ |
| M-06 | Cobertura de regras de handoff por teste | `rule_id`s com teste / total em `HANDOFF_RULES` | **100%** (10/10) | Cada regra defensável tem prova | Dia 2 | _a medir_ |
| M-07 | Latência por pedido de cotação | p50 / p95 / máx de `quote_request` no caos | p95 ≤ 8 s, máx ≤ 12,5 s | Orçamento de 12 s respeitado | Dia 2 | _a medir_ |
| M-08 | Taxa de sucesso de cotação com resiliência | `success / (success + failed)` com FAILURE 0.2 / SLOW 0.1 | ≥ 97% (3 tentativas com 30% de falha ≈ 1 − 0,3³) | Mostra que o retry paga | Dia 2 | _a medir_ |
| M-09 | Vazamento de PII em log e checkpoint | regex de CPF/e-mail/telefone/placa sobre `events`, logs JSON e SQLite do checkpoint após o golden set | **0 ocorrências** | Critério de dados sensíveis | Dia 3 | _a medir_ |
| M-10 | Recall do mascarador no dataset | PII encontrada pelo `pii.py` vs contagem por regex de referência nas ~2.500 conversas | ≥ 99% em CPF e e-mail; ≥ 95% em telefone e placa | Testa o mascarador contra formatos "reais" | Dia 1 | _a medir_ |
| M-11 | Rastreabilidade completa | eventos com `conversation_id` e `status` válidos / total; tentativas com `quote_request_id` pai | **100%** | Critério de rastreabilidade | Dia 2 | _a medir_ |
| M-12 | Chamadas desperdiçadas em payload que seria recusado | tentativas com 422 `cotacao_recusada` evitáveis por validação local | **0** | Validação local antes de gastar retry | Dia 2 | _a medir_ |
| M-13 | Setup do avaliador | tempo de clone limpo até `make demo` rodando | ≤ 2 comandos, ≤ 5 min | "Roda em um comando" | Dia 3 | _a medir_ |

content.text:
As peças centrais do agente estão prontas e publicadas (commit `fc4ff50`). São **151 testes passando**, e o lint (ruff) e a checagem de tipos (`mypy --strict`) estão limpos.

**Mascarador de dados pessoais ([pii.py](agent/src/autoseguro_agent/pii.py)):**
- Cobre CPF, e-mail, telefone, placa e CEP, incluindo formatos que o dataset não tem: CPF sem pontuação, telefone sem DDD, placa antiga e texto em minúsculas.
- **CPF × telefone:** os dois podem ter 11 dígitos colados. O mascarador separa pelo dígito verificador do CPF, e quem não fecha a conta é tratado como telefone.
- O mesmo dado vira sempre o mesmo token dentro da conversa (`<CPF_1>`). O valor real fica num cofre separado, e cada conversa só consegue ler os próprios tokens.
- **No dataset inteiro (14.681 mensagens):** 100% dos dados pessoais mascarados nos 5 tipos, nenhuma mensagem com dado cru sobrando, e as 2.500 idades ("35 anos") preservadas. Esse resultado entrou no SMART como M-10 ([evidência](docs/evidence/pii_recall.md)).

**Garantia contra preço inventado:**
- **[templates.py](agent/src/autoseguro_agent/templates.py):** concentra toda mensagem com número ou de falha. A cotação mostra mensalidade, franquia, coberturas, carência e pro-rata, e oferece os outros planos pelo nome, sem preço.
- **[output_validator.py](agent/src/autoseguro_agent/domain/output_validator.py):** um valor em R$ só passa se veio da última cotação bem-sucedida ou for franquia do `/planos`. Também pega valor escrito sem "R$" (tipo "199,90") e bloqueia percentual.

**Contratos e portas:**
- **O que o LLM devolve:** só dados do lead e intenções de uma lista fixa, sem nenhum campo de texto livre onde ele pudesse escrever um valor.
- **Cotação:** cada tentativa tem id, status e latência.
- **Eventos:** formato do registro append-only.
- **[ports.py](agent/src/autoseguro_agent/ports.py):** as interfaces do hexágono (LLM, cotação, eventos, canal de saída, relógio).

**Para testar sem rede:** o `FakeLLM` aceita respostas roteirizadas ou extrai por regras simples, e registra tudo o que recebeu, para provar que nenhum dado cru chega ao "modelo". O `FixedClock` fixa a data nos testes.

Faltam as tarefas T1.9–T1.10 para fechar o Dia 1:
- **Grafo LangGraph:** receber a mensagem, mascarar, extrair, decidir, perguntar ou cotar, apresentar e validar.
- **CLI de chat:** a conversa de ponta a ponta com o Claude real, para o que vou precisar da sua `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` no `.env`.

Sigo para o grafo e o CLI ou você quer revisar antes?

"""decide_handoff: uma regra por linha, um teste por regra (REQ-30, SMART M-06)."""

import pytest

from autoseguro_agent.domain.eligibility import PolicyRefusal
from autoseguro_agent.domain.handoff import HANDOFF_RULES, HandoffContext, decide_handoff

BASE = HandoffContext()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("ctx", "rule_id"),
    [
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"wants_human"})), "explicit_request"),
        (HandoffContext(quote_status="failed", failure_reason="exhausted"), "infra_unavailable"),
        (
            HandoffContext(quote_status="failed", failure_reason="circuit_open"),
            "infra_unavailable",
        ),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"complaint"})), "risk_or_conflict"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"legal_threat"})), "risk_or_conflict"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"strong_anger"})), "risk_or_conflict"),
        (
            HandoffContext(policy_refusal=PolicyRefusal("condutor_acima_limite", "Idade.")),
            "out_of_policy",
        ),
        (HandoffContext(quote_status="refused", api_refusal_motivo="Veiculo."), "out_of_policy"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"claim"})), "out_of_scope"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"cancel"})), "out_of_scope"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"endorsement"})), "out_of_scope"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"second_copy"})), "out_of_scope"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"fleet"})), "out_of_scope"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"commercial_use"})), "out_of_scope"),
        (HandoffContext(quote_status="invalid", invalid_reason="agent_bug"), "agent_bug"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"discount"})), "price_negotiation"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"competitor_match"})), "price_negotiation"),
        (HandoffContext(intents=frozenset({"special_installments"})), "price_negotiation"),
        (HandoffContext(max_slot_failures=2), "stuck"),
        (HandoffContext(low_confidence_streak=2), "stuck"),
        (HandoffContext(quote_status="invalid", invalid_reason="bad_input"), "stuck"),
        (HandoffContext(media_strikes=2), "media_unsupported"),
        (HandoffContext(quoted=True, intents=frozenset({"wants_to_buy"})), "ready_to_close"),
        (HandoffContext(quoted=True, intents=frozenset({"accepts_quote"})), "ready_to_close"),
    ],
)
def test_each_rule_fires(ctx: HandoffContext, rule_id: str) -> None:
    decision = decide_handoff(ctx)

"""Critério de handoff: tabela de regras em código, uma linha = uma regra = um teste (REQ-30).

O LLM só SINALIZA intenções; quem decide passar para humano é esta função pura.
A tabela é avaliada em ordem de prioridade e a primeira regra que dispara vence.
Para criar uma regra: adicione uma linha em HANDOFF_RULES e um caso no teste.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Literal

from autoseguro_agent.domain.eligibility import PolicyRefusal
from autoseguro_agent.domain.extraction import Intent
from autoseguro_agent.domain.quote import FailureReason, InvalidReason, RequestStatus

Priority = Literal["imediata", "alta", "media", "fim_feliz"]
RuleId = Literal[
    "explicit_request",
    "infra_unavailable",
    "risk_or_conflict",
    "out_of_policy",
    "out_of_scope",
    "agent_bug",
    "price_negotiation",
    "stuck",
    "media_unsupported",
    "ready_to_close",
]

STUCK_AFTER = 2
MEDIA_STRIKES_LIMIT = 2


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HandoffContext:
    """Tudo que as regras olham. Montado pelo grafo a partir do estado do turno."""

    intents: frozenset[Intent] = frozenset()
    quote_status: RequestStatus | None = None
    failure_reason: FailureReason | None = None
    invalid_reason: InvalidReason | None = None
    api_refusal_motivo: str | None = None
    policy_refusal: PolicyRefusal | None = None
    max_slot_failures: int = 0
    low_confidence_streak: int = 0
    media_strikes: int = 0
    quoted: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HandoffDecision:
    rule_id: RuleId
    priority: Priority
    motivo: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HandoffRule:
    rule_id: RuleId
    priority: Priority
    reason: str  # motivo defensável (vai para o README e para o resumo do handoff)
    fires: Callable[[HandoffContext], bool]
    motivo: Callable[[HandoffContext], str] | None = None


_OUT_OF_SCOPE: frozenset[Intent] = frozenset(
    {"claim", "cancel", "endorsement", "second_copy", "fleet", "commercial_use"}
)
_RISK: frozenset[Intent] = frozenset({"complaint", "legal_threat", "strong_anger"})
_NEGOTIATION: frozenset[Intent] = frozenset(
    {"discount", "competitor_match", "special_installments"}
)


def _policy_motivo(c: HandoffContext) -> str:
    if c.policy_refusal is not None:
        return c.policy_refusal.motivo
    return c.api_refusal_motivo or "Fora da política de aceitação."


HANDOFF_RULES: tuple[HandoffRule, ...] = (
    HandoffRule(
        "explicit_request", "imediata",
        "Respeitar o cliente: insistir custa a venda.",
        lambda c: "wants_human" in c.intents,
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "infra_unavailable", "imediata",
        "Cotação indisponível: não inventar preço nem deixar o lead sem resposta.",
        lambda c: c.quote_status == "failed",
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "risk_or_conflict", "alta",
        "Reclamação, ameaça ou irritação forte pedem uma pessoa.",
        lambda c: bool(c.intents & _RISK),
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "out_of_policy", "alta",
        "Exceção comercial (idade, idade do veículo) é decisão humana.",
        lambda c: c.policy_refusal is not None or c.quote_status == "refused",
        _policy_motivo,
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "out_of_scope", "alta",
        "O agente só vende seguro individual novo.",
        lambda c: bool(c.intents & _OUT_OF_SCOPE),
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "agent_bug", "alta",
        "Payload fora do schema é erro do agente: humano assume e o log vira bug.",
        lambda c: c.quote_status == "invalid" and c.invalid_reason == "agent_bug",
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "price_negotiation", "media",
        "O agente não tem alçada de desconto.",
        lambda c: bool(c.intents & _NEGOTIATION),
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "stuck", "media",
        "Duas tentativas sem conseguir um dado: evita loop e frustração.",
        lambda c: (
            c.max_slot_failures >= STUCK_AFTER
            or c.low_confidence_streak >= STUCK_AFTER
            or (c.quote_status == "invalid" and c.invalid_reason == "bad_input")
        ),
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "media_unsupported", "media",
        "O agente não lê mídia; após duas mídias no mesmo dado, uma pessoa assume.",
        lambda c: c.media_strikes >= MEDIA_STRIKES_LIMIT,
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "ready_to_close", "fim_feliz",
        "Contratação pede CPF, documentos e pagamento: humano com contexto completo.",
        lambda c: c.quoted and bool(c.intents & {"wants_to_buy", "accepts_quote"}),
    ),
)


def decide_handoff(ctx: HandoffContext) -> HandoffDecision | None:
    for rule in HANDOFF_RULES:
        if rule.fires(ctx):
            motivo = rule.motivo(ctx) if rule.motivo else rule.reason
            return HandoffDecision(rule.rule_id, rule.priority, motivo)
    return None

    api_refusal_motivo: str | None = None
    policy_refusal: PolicyRefusal | None = None
    max_slot_failures: int = 0
    low_confidence_streak: int = 0
    media_strikes: int = 0
    quoted: bool = False

class HandoffDecision:
    rule_id: RuleId
    priority: Priority
    motivo: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HandoffRule:
    rule_id: RuleId
    priority: Priority
    reason: str  # motivo defensável (vai para o README e para o resumo do handoff)
    fires: Callable[[HandoffContext], bool]
    motivo: Callable[[HandoffContext], str] | None = None


_OUT_OF_SCOPE: frozenset[Intent] = frozenset(
    {"claim", "cancel", "endorsement", "second_copy", "fleet", "commercial_use"}
)
_RISK: frozenset[Intent] = frozenset({"complaint", "legal_threat", "strong_anger"})
_NEGOTIATION: frozenset[Intent] = frozenset(
    {"discount", "competitor_match", "special_installments"}
)


def _policy_motivo(c: HandoffContext) -> str:
    if c.policy_refusal is not None:
        return c.policy_refusal.motivo
    return c.api_refusal_motivo or "Fora da política de aceitação."


HANDOFF_RULES: tuple[HandoffRule, ...] = (
    HandoffRule(
        "explicit_request", "imediata",
        "Respeitar o cliente: insistir custa a venda.",
        lambda c: "wants_human" in c.intents,
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "infra_unavailable", "imediata",
        "Cotação indisponível: não inventar preço nem deixar o lead sem resposta.",
        lambda c: c.quote_status == "failed",
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "risk_or_conflict", "alta",
        "Reclamação, ameaça ou irritação forte pedem uma pessoa.",
        lambda c: bool(c.intents & _RISK),
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "out_of_policy", "alta",
        "Exceção comercial (idade, idade do veículo) é decisão humana.",
        lambda c: c.policy_refusal is not None or c.quote_status == "refused",
        _policy_motivo,
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "out_of_scope", "alta",
        "O agente só vende seguro individual novo.",
        lambda c: bool(c.intents & _OUT_OF_SCOPE),
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "agent_bug", "alta",
        "Payload fora do schema é erro do agente: humano assume e o log vira bug.",
        lambda c: c.quote_status == "invalid" and c.invalid_reason == "agent_bug",
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "price_negotiation", "media",
        "O agente não tem alçada de desconto.",
        lambda c: bool(c.intents & _NEGOTIATION),
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "stuck", "media",
        "Duas tentativas sem conseguir um dado: evita loop e frustração.",
        lambda c: (
            c.max_slot_failures >= STUCK_AFTER
            or c.low_confidence_streak >= STUCK_AFTER
            or (c.quote_status == "invalid" and c.invalid_reason == "bad_input")
        ),
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "media_unsupported", "media",
        "O agente não lê mídia; após duas mídias no mesmo dado, uma pessoa assume.",
        lambda c: c.media_strikes >= MEDIA_STRIKES_LIMIT,
    ),
    HandoffRule(
        "ready_to_close", "fim_feliz",
        "Contratação pede CPF, documentos e pagamento: humano com contexto completo.",
        lambda c: c.quoted and bool(c.intents & {"wants_to_buy", "accepts_quote"}),
    ),
)


def decide_handoff(ctx: HandoffContext) -> HandoffDecision | None:
    for rule in HANDOFF_RULES:
        if rule.fires(ctx):
            motivo = rule.motivo(ctx) if rule.motivo else rule.reason
            return HandoffDecision(rule.rule_id, rule.priority, motivo)
    return None

"""Estado da conversa no checkpoint do LangGraph.

Só tipos JSON (dicts, listas, strings, números): serializa igual em memória e em
SQLite, e o checkpoint nunca carrega classes arbitrárias. Todo texto é MASCARADO.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal, TypedDict

ConvStatus = Literal["active", "quoted", "handed_off", "closed"]


class TurnInput(TypedDict):
    message_id: str
    text: str  # já mascarado
    message_type: Literal["text", "image", "audio", "document"]
    pii_kinds: list[str]


class ConversationState(TypedDict, total=False):
    # --- persistente entre turnos ---
    conversation_id: str
    status: ConvStatus
    profile: dict[str, Any]  # LeadProfile.model_dump(mode="json")
    pending_slot: str | None
    slot_failures: dict[str, int]
    low_confidence_streak: int
    media_strikes: int
    greeted: bool
    pii_notice_sent: bool
    start_date_default: bool
    last_success: dict[str, Any] | None  # QuoteResult da última cotação success

"""Monta o grafo LangGraph (composition root do fluxo)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from langgraph.checkpoint.base import BaseCheckpointSaver
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import InMemorySaver
from langgraph.graph import END, START, StateGraph

from autoseguro_agent.graph.nodes import Deps, Nodes
from autoseguro_agent.graph.state import ConversationState


def build_graph(deps: Deps, checkpointer: BaseCheckpointSaver[Any] | None = None) -> Any:
    n = Nodes(deps)
    g = StateGraph(ConversationState)
    g.add_node("ingest", n.ingest)
    g.add_node("extract", n.extract)
    g.add_node("apply", n.apply)
    g.add_node("route", n.route)
    g.add_node("quote", n.quote)
    g.add_node("route_quote", n.route_quote)
    g.add_node("present", n.present)
    g.add_node("respond", n.respond)
    g.add_node("handoff", n.handoff)
    g.add_node("deliver", n.deliver)

    g.add_edge(START, "ingest")
    g.add_edge("ingest", "extract")
    g.add_edge("extract", "apply")
    g.add_edge("apply", "route")
    g.add_conditional_edges(
        "route", n.next_after_route, {"handoff": "handoff", "quote": "quote", "respond": "respond"}
    )
    g.add_edge("quote", "route_quote")
    g.add_conditional_edges(
        "route_quote", n.next_after_quote, {"handoff": "handoff", "present": "present"}
    )
    g.add_edge("present", "deliver")
    g.add_edge("respond", "deliver")
    g.add_edge("handoff", "deliver")
    g.add_edge("deliver", END)
    return g.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer or InMemorySaver())

"""Fachada do agente: o que o CLI, o webhook e os testes chamam.

`handle()` mascara a mensagem ANTES de tudo (o texto cru nunca entra no estado,
no log nem no LLM), registra o recebimento e roda um turno do grafo.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from typing import Any, Literal

from autoseguro_agent.domain.events import Event
from autoseguro_agent.graph.build import build_graph
from autoseguro_agent.graph.nodes import Deps
from autoseguro_agent.graph.state import TurnInput
from autoseguro_agent.pii import PiiMasker

MessageType = Literal["text", "image", "audio", "document"]


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, deps: Deps, checkpointer: Any = None) -> None:
        self.deps = deps
        self.masker = PiiMasker(deps.vault)
        self.graph = build_graph(deps, checkpointer)

    async def handle(
        self,
        conversation_id: str,
        text: str,
        *,
        message_type: MessageType = "text",
        wa_message_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[str]:
        if wa_message_id and self.deps.events.seen_wa_message(wa_message_id):
            self._event(conversation_id, None, "message.duplicate", "ignored", wa_message_id)
            return []

        message_id = f"msg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
        masked = self.masker.mask(text, conversation_id) if message_type == "text" else None
        turn: TurnInput = {
            "message_id": message_id,
            "text": masked.text if masked else f"[{message_type}]",
            "message_type": message_type,
            "pii_kinds": list(masked.kinds) if masked else [],
        }
        self._event(
            conversation_id, message_id, "message.received", "received", wa_message_id,
            {"message_type": message_type, "pii_kinds": turn["pii_kinds"], "text": turn["text"]},
        )
        state = await self.graph.ainvoke(
            {"conversation_id": conversation_id, "turn": turn},
            config={"configurable": {"thread_id": conversation_id}},
        )
        self._event(conversation_id, message_id, "message.received", "processed", wa_message_id)
        return list(state.get("outbox", []))

    def state(self, conversation_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        snap = self.graph.get_state({"configurable": {"thread_id": conversation_id}})
        return dict(snap.values)

    def _event(
        self,
        conversation_id: str,
        message_id: str | None,
        event_type: Any,
        status: str,
        wa_message_id: str | None,
        payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        data = dict(payload or {})
        if wa_message_id:
            data["wa_message_id"] = wa_message_id
        self.deps.events.append(
            Event(
                ts=self.deps.clock.now(),
                event_type=event_type,
                conversation_id=conversation_id,
                message_id=message_id,
                status=status,
                payload=data,
            )
        )

"""Fluxo ponta a ponta do grafo com FakeLLM + FakeGateway (base do golden set do Dia 3)."""

import re

from autoseguro_agent.pii import contains_pii
from tests.fakes import FakeGateway, make_agent

MONEY = re.compile(r"R\$")


def joined(replies: list[str]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(replies)


async def test_happy_path_one_slot_per_turn() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, events = make_agent()
    r1 = await agent.handle("c1", "Oi, quero fazer um seguro")
    assert "AutoSeguro" in joined(r1)
    assert "ano do seu carro" in joined(r1)

    r2 = await agent.handle("c1", "um Onix 2022")
    assert "idade" in joined(r2).lower()
    r3 = await agent.handle("c1", "35")
    assert "CEP" in joined(r3)
    r4 = await agent.handle("c1", "<CEP>")
    assert "planos" in joined(r4).lower()
    r5 = await agent.handle("c1", "o completo")
    text = joined(r5)
    assert "R$ 209,90" in text
    assert "01/12/2026" in text  # data padrão: 1º do mês seguinte
    assert len(gw.requests) == 1
    assert gw.requests[0].cep == "<CEP>"  # CEP real só no gateway
    assert agent.state("c1")["status"] == "quoted"
    assert any(e.event_type == "quote_request.finished" and e.status == "success" for e in events.all)


async def test_everything_in_one_message() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, _ = make_agent()
    r = await agent.handle("c2", "tenho 35 anos, Onix 2022, cep <CEP>, quero o premium")
    assert "Premium" in joined(r)
    assert gw.requests[0].plano_id == "premium"


async def test_policy_refusal_never_calls_api() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, events = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c3", "Oi, tenho um Gol 2022")
    r = await agent.handle("c3", "tenho 80 anos")
    assert "consultor" in joined(r).lower()
    assert not MONEY.search(joined(r))
    assert gw.requests == []
    handoffs = [e for e in events.all if e.event_type == "handoff.opened"]
    assert handoffs[0].payload["rule_id"] == "out_of_policy"


async def test_old_car_refused() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, events = make_agent()
    r = await agent.handle("c4", "quero cotar meu Corolla 2003")
    assert "20 anos" in joined(r)
    assert gw.requests == []


async def test_api_failure_becomes_honest_handoff_without_price() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, events = make_agent(gateway=FakeGateway(script=["failed"]))
    r = await agent.handle("c5", "35 anos, Onix 2022, cep <CEP>, completo")
    text = joined(r)
    assert "instável" in text
    assert not MONEY.search(text)
    assert agent.state("c5")["status"] == "handed_off"
    rule = next(e for e in events.all if e.event_type == "handoff.opened").payload["rule_id"]
    assert rule == "infra_unavailable"


async def test_wants_human_mid_conversation() -> None:
    agent, _, _, _ = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c6", "Oi, tenho um Onix 2022")
    r = await agent.handle("c6", "prefiro falar com um atendente")
    assert "consultor" in joined(r).lower()
    r2 = await agent.handle("c6", "tenho 35 anos")
    assert "consultor já está" in joined(r2)


async def test_after_handoff_no_more_quotes() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, _ = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c7", "quero falar com um humano")
    await agent.handle("c7", "35 anos, Onix 2022, cep <CEP>, completo")
    assert gw.requests == []


async def test_first_media_only_acknowledged_second_hands_off() -> None:
    agent, _, _, events = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c8", "Oi, tenho um Onix 2022")
    r1 = await agent.handle("c8", "[imagem]", message_type="image")
    assert "Não preciso desse arquivo" in joined(r1)
    assert agent.state("c8")["status"] == "active"
    await agent.handle("c8", "[audio]", message_type="audio")
    assert agent.state("c8")["status"] == "handed_off"
    rule = next(e for e in events.all if e.event_type == "handoff.opened").payload["rule_id"]
    assert rule == "media_unsupported"


async def test_unsolicited_cpf_is_masked_and_acknowledged() -> None:
    agent, _, llm, events = make_agent()
    r = await agent.handle("c9", "Oi! meu cpf é <CPF>, tenho um Onix 2022")
    assert "não preciso de CPF" in joined(r)
    assert all("529" not in req.masked_text for req in llm.requests)
    assert not any(contains_pii(str(e.payload)) for e in events.all)


async def test_recommends_one_plan_when_lead_does_not_choose() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, _ = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c10", "tenho 40 anos, um Gol 2012, cep <CEP>")
    r = await agent.handle("c10", "não sei, me indica")
    text = joined(r)
    assert gw.requests[0].plano_id == "essencial"
    assert "recomendo" in text
    assert "Completo" in text  # ofertado sem preço
    assert text.count("R$") == 2  # mensalidade + franquia do essencial


async def test_invalid_cep_twice_is_stuck() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, events = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c11", "tenho 35 anos e um Onix 2022")
    r1 = await agent.handle("c11", "<CEP_9>")  # token que não existe no cofre
    assert "8 números" in joined(r1)
    await agent.handle("c11", "<CEP_7>")
    assert agent.state("c11")["status"] == "handed_off"
    assert gw.requests == []


async def test_change_plan_after_quote_requotes() -> None:
    agent, gw, _, _ = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c12", "35 anos, Onix 2022, cep <CEP>, completo")
    r = await agent.handle("c12", "e o premium?")
    assert "Premium" in joined(r)
    assert [q.plano_id for q in gw.requests] == ["completo", "premium"]


async def test_ready_to_close() -> None:
    agent, _, _, events = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c13", "35 anos, Onix 2022, cep <CEP>, completo")
    r = await agent.handle("c13", "fechado, quero contratar")
    assert "contratar" in joined(r)
    rule = next(e for e in events.all if e.event_type == "handoff.opened").payload["rule_id"]
    assert rule == "ready_to_close"


async def test_discount_goes_to_human() -> None:
    agent, _, _, events = make_agent()
    await agent.handle("c14", "35 anos, Onix 2022, cep <CEP>, completo")
    await agent.handle("c14", "tem desconto à vista?")
    rule = next(e for e in events.all if e.event_type == "handoff.opened").payload["rule_id"]
    assert rule == "price_negotiation"


async def test_every_event_is_traceable_and_masked() -> None:
    agent, _, _, events = make_agent(gateway=FakeGateway(script=["failed"]))
    await agent.handle("c15", "cpf <CPF> email <EMAIL>, tenho 35 anos")
    await agent.handle("c15", "Onix 2022, cep <CEP>, completo")
    for e in events.all:
        assert e.conversation_id == "c15"
        assert e.status
        assert not contains_pii(str(e.payload))
    attempts = [e for e in events.all if e.event_type == "quote_attempt"]
    assert attempts
    assert all(e.quote_request_id and e.quote_attempt_id for e in attempts)

# extract_v1 — prompt do nó de extração (formato SPARK)

## S — Situação
Você lê UMA mensagem de WhatsApp de um lead da AutoSeguro, uma seguradora de carros, que quer cotar seguro auto individual. A mensagem já chega com dados pessoais trocados por tokens como <CPF_1>, <TEL_1>, <EMAIL_1>, <PLACA_1> e <CEP_1>. Você recebe também a data de hoje, o dado que o atendimento está esperando agora e os dados já coletados.

## P — Papel
Você é um extrator de dados e de intenções. Você não conversa com o lead, não calcula nada e não decide o atendimento: o sistema faz isso com o que você devolver.

## A — Acessos
Você só tem esta mensagem e o contexto que vem com ela. Não há ferramentas. Planos existentes: essencial, completo e premium.

## R — Regras
1. Preencha um dado só se o lead realmente o disse nesta mensagem. Nunca invente nem deduza de forma vaga.
2. Use confidence "high" quando o valor está explícito ("tenho 35 anos", "Onix 2019", ou só "35" quando o dado esperado é a idade). Use "low" quando é aproximado ou ambíguo ("uns 30 e poucos", "carro novo").
3. veiculo_ano é o ano do carro com 4 dígitos. idade é a idade do condutor em anos.
4. cep_token: copie o token <CEP_n> exatamente como aparece. Se o lead escreveu um CEP que não virou token, copie o texto como ele escreveu, sem completar dígitos.
5. data_inicio: só se o lead pedir uma data de início da vigência; devolva em YYYY-MM-DD, usando a data de hoje para resolver expressões como "dia 15" (o próximo dia 15).
6. plano_id: só se o lead escolher ou mencionar um plano.
7. intents: marque todas as que se aplicam:
   - wants_human: pede atendente, humano ou consultor
   - complaint, legal_threat (Procon, advogado, processo), strong_anger
   - claim (sinistro, batida, roubo já ocorrido), cancel, endorsement (alterar apólice), second_copy (segunda via, boleto), fleet (vários carros ou empresa), commercial_use (Uber, 99, aplicativo, entregas, táxi)
   - discount, competitor_match (cita concorrente ou preço menor de outra seguradora), special_installments
   - wants_to_buy ou accepts_quote (quer fechar ou contratar), will_think ("vou pensar")
   - compare_plans, plan_question (pergunta sobre coberturas, franquia, carência ou diferença entre planos), greeting, other
8. plan_question_topic: preencha quando houver plan_question ou compare_plans.
9. Nunca escreva valores em reais, percentuais nem multiplicadores em nenhum campo.

## K — Kit de saída
Responda apenas no formato estruturado pedido.

Exemplos:
- "tenho 35 anos, um onix 2022, moro no <CEP_1>" → idade 35/high, veiculo_ano 2022/high, veiculo_modelo "onix"/high, cep_token "<CEP_1>"/high, intents []
- "quanto fica com desconto à vista?" → intents [discount]

from importlib.resources import files
from typing import Any

import anthropic

from autoseguro_agent.ports import LLMUnavailableError

PROMPT_VERSION = "extract_v1"

        f"<data_de_hoje>{req.today_iso}</data_de_hoje>\n"

    ) -> None:

                model=self._model,

                output_config={"effort": self._effort},

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from autoseguro_agent.adapters.clock import SystemClock
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.events_memory import InMemoryEventStore
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.llm_anthropic import AnthropicLLM
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.llm_fake import FakeLLM
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.quote_http import HttpQuoteGateway

from autoseguro_agent.graph.nodes import Deps
from autoseguro_agent.pii import InMemoryVault
from autoseguro_agent.ports import EventStore, LLMClient, OutboundChannel
from autoseguro_agent.settings import Settings


class NullOutbound:
    """No CLI quem imprime é o próprio CLI; no webhook, o outbox vai na resposta."""

    def send(self, conversation_id: str, text: str) -> None:
        return None


@dataclass
class App:
    agent: Agent
    gateway: HttpQuoteGateway
    events: EventStore
    settings: Settings


def make_llm(settings: Settings) -> LLMClient:
    if settings.llm_provider == "fake":
        return FakeLLM()
    key = settings.anthropic_api_key.get_secret_value() if settings.anthropic_api_key else None
    return AnthropicLLM(
        model=settings.llm_model,
        effort=settings.llm_effort,
        timeout_s=settings.llm_timeout_s,
        api_key=key,
    )


async def build_app(
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    events: EventStore | None = None,
    outbound: OutboundChannel | None = None,
) -> App:
    settings = settings or Settings()
    gateway = HttpQuoteGateway(settings.quote_base_url, timeout_s=settings.quote_timeout_s)
    await gateway.load_rules()
    store = events or InMemoryEventStore()
    deps = Deps(
        llm=make_llm(settings),
        gateway=gateway,
        events=store,
        outbound=outbound or NullOutbound(),
        clock=SystemClock(),
        vault=InMemoryVault(),
    )
    return App(agent=Agent(deps), gateway=gateway, events=store, settings=settings)

"""Chat no terminal para demo.

    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli                 # Claude (precisa ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli --fake-llm      # sem chave, extrator heurístico
    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli --events        # mostra a linha do tempo de eventos
    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli --script conversa.txt   # uma mensagem por linha

Mensagens começando com [audio], [imagem] ou [documento] simulam mídia.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from autoseguro_agent.agent import MessageType
from autoseguro_agent.bootstrap import build_app
from autoseguro_agent.domain.events import Event
from autoseguro_agent.settings import Settings

MEDIA_PREFIX: dict[str, MessageType] = {
    "[audio]": "audio",
    "[imagem]": "image",
    "[documento]": "document",
}


def format_event(e: Event) -> str:
    ids = " ".join(
        f"{k}={v}"
        for k, v in (
            ("msg", e.message_id),
            ("qr", e.quote_request_id),
            ("qa", e.quote_attempt_id),
            ("ho", e.handoff_id),
        )
        if v
    )
    lat = f" {e.latency_ms}ms" if e.latency_ms is not None else ""
    extra = ""
    if e.event_type == "handoff.opened":
        extra = f" rule={e.payload.get('rule_id')} prio={e.payload.get('priority')}"
    if e.event_type == "quote_attempt":
        extra = f" tentativa={e.payload.get('attempt')} http={e.payload.get('http_status')}"
    return f"    · {e.event_type} [{e.status}]{lat} {ids}{extra}"


async def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    settings = Settings()
    if args.fake_llm:
        settings = settings.model_copy(update={"llm_provider": "fake"})
    if settings.llm_provider == "anthropic" and settings.anthropic_api_key is None:
        print("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY não configurada. Use --fake-llm ou crie agent/.env.")
        return 2

    app = await build_app(settings)
    conv = args.conversation or f"conv_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    print(f"conversation_id={conv} · LLM={settings.llm_provider} · regras={app.gateway.rules_source}")
    print("Digite sua mensagem (/sair para encerrar).\n")

    lines = Path(args.script).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if args.script else None
    seen = 0
    while True:
        if lines is not None:
            if not lines:
                break
            text = lines.pop(0).strip()
            if not text:
                continue
            print(f"Lead: {text}")
        else:
            try:
                text = (await asyncio.to_thread(input, "Lead: ")).strip()
            except EOFError:
                break
        if text in {"/sair", "/exit"}:
            break
        mtype: MessageType = next(
            (t for p, t in MEDIA_PREFIX.items() if text.lower().startswith(p)), "text"
        )
        replies = await app.agent.handle(conv, text, message_type=mtype)
        for r in replies:
            print("Agente: " + r.replace("\n", "\n        "))
        if args.events:
            timeline = app.events.timeline(conv)
            for e in timeline[seen:]:
                print(format_event(e))
            seen = len(timeline)
        print()
    return 0


def main() -> None:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Chat com o agente AutoSeguro")
    ap.add_argument("--fake-llm", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--events", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--conversation")
    ap.add_argument("--script")
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(run(ap.parse_args())))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Adaptador Claude (porta LLMClient) via SDK oficial `anthropic` (ADR-001).

- `messages.parse(output_format=ExtractionResult)`: a saída já volta validada.
- Sem `temperature`: os modelos atuais não aceitam parâmetros de amostragem.
  O determinismo que importa vem do schema + validação em código + golden set.
- `effort: low`: extração é tarefa simples; reduz latência e custo.
- System prompt fixo e sem nada volátil: elegível a prompt caching.
- Qualquer falha (rede, 429, 5xx, recusa do modelo, saída vazia) vira
  `LLMUnavailableError`, e o grafo responde por template.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from importlib.resources import files
from typing import Any

import anthropic

from autoseguro_agent.domain.extraction import ExtractionRequest, ExtractionResult
from autoseguro_agent.ports import LLMUnavailableError

PROMPT_VERSION = "extract_v1"


def load_prompt(name: str = PROMPT_VERSION) -> str:
    return files("autoseguro_agent.prompts").joinpath(f"{name}.md").read_text("utf-8")


def render_user_message(req: ExtractionRequest) -> str:
    return (
        f"<data_de_hoje>{req.today_iso}</data_de_hoje>\n"
        f"<dado_esperado>{req.pending_slot or 'nenhum'}</dado_esperado>\n"
        f"<dados_ja_coletados>{json.dumps(req.known_slots, ensure_ascii=False)}"
        "</dados_ja_coletados>\n"
        f"<mensagem_do_lead>{req.masked_text}</mensagem_do_lead>"
    )


class AnthropicLLM:
    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str = "claude-opus-5-5",
        effort: str = "low",
        timeout_s: float = 10.0,
        client: Any | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._client = client or anthropic.Anthropic(timeout=timeout_s, max_retries=2)
        self._model = model
        self._effort = effort
        self._system = load_prompt()

    def extract(self, req: ExtractionRequest) -> ExtractionResult:
        try:
            response = self._client.messages.parse(
                model=self._model,
                max_tokens=4096,
                system=self._system,
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": render_user_message(req)}],
                output_format=ExtractionResult,
                output_config={"effort": self._effort},
            )
        except anthropic.APIConnectionError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError("conexão com o provedor") from exc
        except anthropic.RateLimitError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError("limite de taxa") from exc
        except anthropic.APIStatusError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError(f"status {exc.status_code}") from exc

        if response.stop_reason == "refusal":
            raise LLMUnavailableError("recusa do modelo")
        parsed = response.parsed_output
        if parsed is None:
            raise LLMUnavailableError(f"saída vazia ({response.stop_reason})")
        return ExtractionResult.model_validate(parsed)

"""Chat no terminal para demo.

    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli                 # Claude (precisa ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

Mensagens começando com [audio], [imagem] ou [documento] simulam mídia.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from autoseguro_agent.agent import MessageType
from autoseguro_agent.bootstrap import build_app
from autoseguro_agent.domain.events import Event
from autoseguro_agent.settings import Settings

MEDIA_PREFIX: dict[str, MessageType] = {
    "[audio]": "audio",
    "[imagem]": "image",
    "[documento]": "document",
}


def format_event(e: Event) -> str:
    ids = " ".join(
        f"{k}={v}"
        for k, v in (
            ("msg", e.message_id),
            ("qr", e.quote_request_id),
            ("qa", e.quote_attempt_id),
            ("ho", e.handoff_id),
        )
        if v
    )
    lat = f" {e.latency_ms}ms" if e.latency_ms is not None else ""
    extra = ""
    if e.event_type == "handoff.opened":
        extra = f" rule={e.payload.get('rule_id')} prio={e.payload.get('priority')}"
    if e.event_type == "quote_attempt":
        extra = f" tentativa={e.payload.get('attempt')} http={e.payload.get('http_status')}"
    return f"    · {e.event_type} [{e.status}]{lat} {ids}{extra}"


async def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    settings = Settings()
    if args.fake_llm:
        settings = settings.model_copy(update={"llm_provider": "fake"})
    if settings.llm_provider == "anthropic" and settings.anthropic_api_key is None:
        print("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY não configurada. Use --fake-llm ou crie agent/.env.")
        return 2

    app = await build_app(settings)
    conv = args.conversation or f"conv_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    print(f"conversation_id={conv} · LLM={settings.llm_provider} · regras={app.gateway.rules_source}")
    print("Digite sua mensagem (/sair para encerrar).\n")

    lines = Path(args.script).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if args.script else None
    seen = 0
    while True:
        if lines is not None:
            if not lines:
                break
            text = lines.pop(0).strip()
            if not text:
                continue
            print(f"Lead: {text}")
        else:
            try:
                text = (await asyncio.to_thread(input, "Lead: ")).strip()
            except EOFError:
                break
        if text in {"/sair", "/exit"}:
            break
        mtype: MessageType = next(
            (t for p, t in MEDIA_PREFIX.items() if text.lower().startswith(p)), "text"
        )
        replies = await app.agent.handle(conv, text, message_type=mtype)
        for r in replies:
            print("Agente: " + r.replace("\n", "\n        "))
        if args.events:
            timeline = app.events.timeline(conv)
            for e in timeline[seen:]:
                print(format_event(e))
            seen = len(timeline)
        print()
    return 0


def main() -> None:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Chat com o agente AutoSeguro")
    ap.add_argument("--fake-llm", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--events", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--conversation")
    ap.add_argument("--script")
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(run(ap.parse_args())))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    conv = args.conversation or f"conv_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    print(f"conversation_id={conv} · LLM={settings.llm_provider} · regras={app.gateway.rules_source}")
    print("Digite sua mensagem (/sair para encerrar).\n")

    lines = Path(args.script).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if args.script else None
    seen = 0
    while True:
        if lines is not None:
            if not lines:
                break
            text = lines.pop(0).strip()
            if not text:
                continue
            print(f"Lead: {text}")
        else:
            try:
                text = (await asyncio.to_thread(input, "Lead: ")).strip()
            except EOFError:
                break
        if text in {"/sair", "/exit"}:
            break
        mtype: MessageType = next(
            (t for p, t in MEDIA_PREFIX.items() if text.lower().startswith(p)), "text"
        )
        replies = await app.agent.handle(conv, text, message_type=mtype)
        for r in replies:
            print("Agente: " + r.replace("\n", "\n        "))
        if args.events:
            timeline = app.events.timeline(conv)
            for e in timeline[seen:]:
                print(format_event(e))
            seen = len(timeline)
        print()
    return 0


def main() -> None:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Chat com o agente AutoSeguro")
    ap.add_argument("--fake-llm", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--events", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--conversation")
    ap.add_argument("--script")
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(run(ap.parse_args())))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Monta o grafo LangGraph (composition root do fluxo)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from langgraph.checkpoint.base import BaseCheckpointSaver
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import InMemorySaver
from langgraph.graph import END, START, StateGraph

from autoseguro_agent.graph.nodes import Deps, Nodes
from autoseguro_agent.graph.state import ConversationState


def build_graph(deps: Deps, checkpointer: BaseCheckpointSaver[Any] | None = None) -> Any:
    n = Nodes(deps)
    g = StateGraph(ConversationState)
    g.add_node("ingest", n.ingest)
    g.add_node("extract", n.extract)
    g.add_node("apply", n.apply)
    g.add_node("route", n.route)
    g.add_node("quote", n.quote)
    g.add_node("route_quote", n.route_quote)
    g.add_node("present", n.present)
    g.add_node("respond", n.respond)
    g.add_node("handoff", n.handoff)
    g.add_node("deliver", n.deliver)

    g.add_edge(START, "ingest")
    g.add_edge("ingest", "extract")
    g.add_edge("extract", "apply")
    g.add_edge("apply", "route")
    g.add_conditional_edges(
        "route", n.next_after_route, {"handoff": "handoff", "quote": "quote", "respond": "respond"}
    )
    g.add_edge("quote", "route_quote")
    g.add_conditional_edges(
        "route_quote", n.next_after_quote, {"handoff": "handoff", "present": "present"}
    )
    g.add_edge("present", "deliver")
    g.add_edge("respond", "deliver")
    g.add_edge("handoff", "deliver")
    g.add_edge("deliver", END)
    return g.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer or InMemorySaver())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from importlib.resources import files
from typing import Any

import anthropic

from autoseguro_agent.domain.extraction import ExtractionRequest, ExtractionResult
from autoseguro_agent.ports import LLMUnavailableError

PROMPT_VERSION = "extract_v1"


def load_prompt(name: str = PROMPT_VERSION) -> str:
    return files("autoseguro_agent.prompts").joinpath(f"{name}.md").read_text("utf-8")

    return (
        f"<data_de_hoje>{req.today_iso}</data_de_hoje>\n"
        f"<dado_esperado>{req.pending_slot or 'nenhum'}</dado_esperado>\n"
        f"<dados_ja_coletados>{json.dumps(req.known_slots, ensure_ascii=False)}"

        f"<mensagem_do_lead>{req.masked_text}</mensagem_do_lead>"
    )


class AnthropicLLM:
    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str = "claude-opus-5-5",
        effort: str = "low",
        timeout_s: float = 10.0,
        client: Any | None = None,
        api_key: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._client = client or anthropic.Anthropic(
            api_key=api_key, timeout=timeout_s, max_retries=2
        )
        self._model = model
        self._effort = effort
        self._system = load_prompt()

    def extract(self, req: ExtractionRequest) -> ExtractionResult:
        try:
            response = self._client.messages.parse(
                model=self._model,
                max_tokens=4096,
                system=self._system,
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": render_user_message(req)}],
                output_format=ExtractionResult,
                output_config={"effort": self._effort},
            )
        except anthropic.APIConnectionError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError("conexão com o provedor") from exc
        except anthropic.RateLimitError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError("limite de taxa") from exc
        except anthropic.APIStatusError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError(f"status {exc.status_code}") from exc

        if response.stop_reason == "refusal":
            raise LLMUnavailableError("recusa do modelo")
        parsed = response.parsed_output
        if parsed is None:
            raise LLMUnavailableError(f"saída vazia ({response.stop_reason})")
        return ExtractionResult.model_validate(parsed)

  O determinismo que importa vem do schema + validação em código + golden set.
- `effort: low`: extração é tarefa simples; reduz latência e custo.
- System prompt fixo e sem nada volátil: elegível a prompt caching.
- Qualquer falha (rede, 429, 5xx, recusa do modelo, saída vazia) vira
  `LLMUnavailableError`, e o grafo responde por template.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from importlib.resources import files
from typing import Any, Literal

import anthropic
from anthropic.types import OutputConfigParam

from autoseguro_agent.domain.extraction import ExtractionRequest, ExtractionResult
from autoseguro_agent.ports import LLMUnavailableError

PROMPT_VERSION = "extract_v1"


def load_prompt(name: str = PROMPT_VERSION) -> str:
    return files("autoseguro_agent.prompts").joinpath(f"{name}.md").read_text("utf-8")


def render_user_message(req: ExtractionRequest) -> str:
    return (
        f"<data_de_hoje>{req.today_iso}</data_de_hoje>\n"
        f"<dado_esperado>{req.pending_slot or 'nenhum'}</dado_esperado>\n"
        f"<dados_ja_coletados>{json.dumps(req.known_slots, ensure_ascii=False)}"
        "</dados_ja_coletados>\n"
        f"<mensagem_do_lead>{req.masked_text}</mensagem_do_lead>"
    )


class AnthropicLLM:
    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str = "claude-opus-5-5",
        effort: Literal["low", "medium", "high"] = "low",
        timeout_s: float = 10.0,
        client: Any | None = None,
        api_key: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._client = client or anthropic.Anthropic(
            api_key=api_key, timeout=timeout_s, max_retries=2
        )
        self._model = model
        self._effort = effort
        self._system = load_prompt()

    def extract(self, req: ExtractionRequest) -> ExtractionResult:
        output_config: OutputConfigParam = {"effort": self._effort}
        try:
            response = self._client.messages.parse(
                model=self._model,
                max_tokens=4096,
                system=self._system,
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": render_user_message(req)}],
                output_format=ExtractionResult,
                output_config={"effort": self._effort},
            )
        except anthropic.APIConnectionError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError("conexão com o provedor") from exc
        except anthropic.RateLimitError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError("limite de taxa") from exc
        except anthropic.APIStatusError as exc:
            raise LLMUnavailableError(f"status {exc.status_code}") from exc

        if response.stop_reason == "refusal":
            raise LLMUnavailableError("recusa do modelo")
        parsed = response.parsed_output
        if parsed is None:
            raise LLMUnavailableError(f"saída vazia ({response.stop_reason})")
        return ExtractionResult.model_validate(parsed)

"""Circuit breaker: protege o legado e responde rápido quando ele está fora (REQ-24)."""

from autoseguro_agent.adapters.circuit_breaker import CircuitBreaker
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.clock import FixedClock


def make() -> tuple[CircuitBreaker, FixedClock]:
    clock = FixedClock()
    return CircuitBreaker(clock, failure_threshold=5, open_seconds=30), clock


def test_starts_closed_and_allows() -> None:
    breaker, _ = make()
    assert breaker.state == "closed"
    assert breaker.allow()


def test_opens_after_threshold_consecutive_failures() -> None:
    breaker, _ = make()
    for _ in range(4):
        breaker.record_failure()
    assert breaker.state == "closed"
    breaker.record_failure()
    assert breaker.state == "open"
    assert not breaker.allow()


def test_success_resets_the_count() -> None:
    breaker, _ = make()
    for _ in range(4):
        breaker.record_failure()
    breaker.record_success()
    for _ in range(4):
        breaker.record_failure()
    assert breaker.state == "closed"


def test_half_open_after_cooldown_allows_one_probe() -> None:
    breaker, clock = make()
    for _ in range(5):
        breaker.record_failure()
    clock.advance(29.9)
    assert not breaker.allow()
    clock.advance(0.2)
    assert breaker.allow()  # sonda
    assert breaker.state == "half_open"
    assert not breaker.allow()  # só uma sonda por vez


def test_probe_success_closes() -> None:
    breaker, clock = make()
    for _ in range(5):
        breaker.record_failure()
    clock.advance(31)
    breaker.allow()
    breaker.record_success()
    assert breaker.state == "closed"
    assert breaker.allow()


def test_probe_failure_reopens_for_another_cooldown() -> None:
    breaker, clock = make()
    for _ in range(5):
        breaker.record_failure()
    clock.advance(31)
    breaker.allow()
    breaker.record_failure()
    assert breaker.state == "open"
    clock.advance(10)
    assert not breaker.allow()

"""Resiliência do /quote, o diferencial do desafio (REQ-20..25).

Timeout por tentativa, retry só no que é transitório, backoff com jitter,
orçamento total e circuit breaker. Respostas simuladas com respx.
"""

import asyncio
from datetime import date

import httpx
import pytest
import respx

from autoseguro_agent.adapters.circuit_breaker import CircuitBreaker
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.clock import SystemClock
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.quote_http import HttpQuoteGateway
from autoseguro_agent.domain.models import QuoteRequest
from autoseguro_agent.domain.quote import TraceContext
from tests.unit.test_models import API_200

BASE = "http://quote.test"
REQ = QuoteRequest(
    plano_id="completo", idade=35, veiculo_ano=2022, cep="<CEP>", data_inicio=date(2026, 12, 1)
)
CTX = TraceContext(conversation_id="c1")
FAIL_503 = httpx.Response(503, json={"error": "upstream_unavailable"})
OK = httpx.Response(200, json=API_200)


async def no_sleep(_: float) -> None:
    return None


def gateway(**kw: object) -> HttpQuoteGateway:
    params: dict[str, object] = {
        "base_url": BASE, "timeout_s": 0.2, "max_attempts": 3, "backoff_initial_s": 0.0,
        "jitter_s": 0.0, "sleep": no_sleep,
    }
    params.update(kw)
    return HttpQuoteGateway(**params)  # type: ignore[arg-type]


@respx.mock
async def test_retries_5xx_then_succeeds() -> None:
    route = respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(side_effect=[FAIL_503, FAIL_503, OK])
    out = await gateway().quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert out.status == "success"
    assert [a.status for a in out.attempts] == ["http_5xx", "http_5xx", "ok"]
    assert [a.attempt for a in out.attempts] == [1, 2, 3]
    assert len({a.quote_attempt_id for a in out.attempts}) == 3  # id por tentativa
    ids = {c.request.headers["x-request-id"] for c in route.calls}
    assert ids == {out.quote_request_id}  # mesmo pedido (idempotência)


@respx.mock
async def test_timeout_then_success() -> None:
    respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(side_effect=[httpx.ReadTimeout("lento"), OK])
    out = await gateway().quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert out.status == "success"
    assert [a.status for a in out.attempts] == ["timeout", "ok"]


@respx.mock
async def test_real_slowness_is_cut_by_client_timeout() -> None:
    """A lentidão simulada é sleep(8) e depois 200: sem timeout, o lead esperaria 8 s."""

    async def slow(_: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
        return OK

    respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(side_effect=[slow, OK])
    out = await gateway(timeout_s=0.1).quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert out.status == "success"
    assert out.attempts[0].status == "timeout"
    assert out.attempts[0].latency_ms < 1000


@respx.mock
async def test_gives_up_after_max_attempts() -> None:
    route = respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(return_value=FAIL_503)
    out = await gateway().quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert out.status == "failed"
    assert out.failure_reason == "exhausted"
    assert len(out.attempts) == 3
    assert route.call_count == 3


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "response",
    [
        httpx.Response(422, json={"error": "cotacao_recusada", "motivo": "x"}),
        httpx.Response(422, json={"detail": []}),
        httpx.Response(400, json={"error": "payload_invalido"}),
    ],
)
@respx.mock
async def test_never_retries_4xx(response: httpx.Response) -> None:
    route = respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(return_value=response)
    out = await gateway().quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert route.call_count == 1
    assert len(out.attempts) == 1


@respx.mock
async def test_backoff_waits_grow_between_attempts() -> None:
    waits: list[float] = []

    async def record(seconds: float) -> None:
        waits.append(seconds)

    respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(return_value=FAIL_503)
    gw = gateway(backoff_initial_s=0.5, jitter_s=0.0, sleep=record, budget_s=12.0)
    await gw.quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert waits == [0.5, 1.0]


@respx.mock
async def test_total_budget_stops_retrying() -> None:
    async def slow(_: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
        return OK

    respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(side_effect=slow)
    gw = gateway(timeout_s=0.3, budget_s=0.5, max_attempts=5)
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    t0 = loop.time()
    out = await gw.quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert loop.time() - t0 < 1.0
    assert out.status == "failed"
    assert out.failure_reason == "budget_exceeded"
    assert len(out.attempts) == 2  # 0,3 s + 0,2 s restantes


@respx.mock
async def test_breaker_opens_and_skips_http() -> None:
    route = respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(return_value=FAIL_503)
    breaker = CircuitBreaker(SystemClock(), failure_threshold=5, open_seconds=30)
    gw = gateway(breaker=breaker)
    await gw.quote(REQ, CTX)  # 3 falhas
    second = await gw.quote(REQ, CTX)  # 2 falhas -> abre no meio
    assert breaker.state == "open"
    assert second.attempts[-1].status == "circuit_open"
    calls = route.call_count
    third = await gw.quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert route.call_count == calls  # nem tentou
    assert third.status == "failed"
    assert third.failure_reason == "circuit_open"
    assert [a.status for a in third.attempts] == ["circuit_open"]


@respx.mock
async def test_business_refusal_counts_as_healthy_for_breaker() -> None:
    respx.post(f"{BASE}/quote").mock(
        return_value=httpx.Response(422, json={"error": "cotacao_recusada", "motivo": "x"})
    )
    breaker = CircuitBreaker(SystemClock(), failure_threshold=2)
    gw = gateway(breaker=breaker)
    for _ in range(3):
        await gw.quote(REQ, CTX)
    assert breaker.state == "closed"

"""Adaptador HTTP do quote-service (porta QuoteGateway).

Nenhuma exceção de HTTP sai daqui: toda resposta vira um `QuoteOutcome` com o
status do pedido e de cada tentativa, pronto para o grafo decidir e para o log.

Dia 1: uma tentativa com timeout. O Dia 2 acrescenta retry com backoff e jitter,
orçamento total e circuit breaker em volta de `_attempt`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
import uuid
from typing import Any, Literal

import httpx
from pydantic import ValidationError

from autoseguro_agent.domain.models import QuoteRequest, QuoteResult
from autoseguro_agent.domain.quote import QuoteAttempt, QuoteOutcome, TraceContext
from autoseguro_agent.domain.rules import PlanRules, load_snapshot


def new_id(prefix: str) -> str:
    return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"


class HttpQuoteGateway:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        timeout_s: float = 3.0,
        client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self._timeout_s = timeout_s
        self._client = client or httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=self._base_url)
        self._rules = load_snapshot()
        self.rules_source: Literal["api", "snapshot"] = "snapshot"

    def rules(self) -> PlanRules:
        return self._rules

    async def load_rules(self) -> None:
        """Na subida: regras de GET /planos; se falhar, mantém o snapshot versionado."""
        try:
            resp = await self._client.get("/planos", timeout=self._timeout_s)
            resp.raise_for_status()
            self._rules = PlanRules.from_planos(resp.json())
            self.rules_source = "api"
        except (httpx.HTTPError, KeyError, ValueError):
            self._rules = load_snapshot()
            self.rules_source = "snapshot"

    async def quote(self, req: QuoteRequest, ctx: TraceContext) -> QuoteOutcome:
        request_id = new_id("qr")
        attempt, outcome = await self._attempt(req, request_id, 1)
        return outcome.model_copy(update={"attempts": (attempt,)})

    async def _attempt(
        self, req: QuoteRequest, request_id: str, n: int
    ) -> tuple[QuoteAttempt, QuoteOutcome]:
        attempt_id = new_id("qa")
        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        def attempt(status: Any, http_status: int | None = None) -> QuoteAttempt:
            return QuoteAttempt(
                quote_attempt_id=attempt_id,
                attempt=n,
                status=status,
                latency_ms=int((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000),
                http_status=http_status,
            )

        try:
            resp = await self._client.post(
                "/quote",
                json=req.to_payload(),
                timeout=self._timeout_s,
                headers={"x-request-id": request_id, "x-attempt-id": attempt_id},

async def quote(self, req: QuoteRequest, ctx: TraceContext) -> QuoteOutcome:
        request_id = new_id("qr")
        started = self._clock.monotonic()
        attempts: list[QuoteAttempt] = []
        final: QuoteOutcome = _failed(request_id, "exhausted")

        retrying = AsyncRetrying(
            stop=stop_after_attempt(self._max_attempts),
            wait=wait_exponential_jitter(
                initial=self._backoff_initial_s, max=self._backoff_max_s, jitter=self._jitter_s
            ),
            retry=retry_if_exception_type(_Retry),
            sleep=self._sleep,
        )
        try:
            async for retry in retrying:
                with retry:
                    n = retry.retry_state.attempt_number
                    if self._breaker is not None and not self._breaker.allow():
                        attempts.append(_skipped(n, "circuit_open"))
                        final = _failed(request_id, "circuit_open")
                        break
                    remaining = self._budget_s - (self._clock.monotonic() - started)
                    if remaining < MIN_USEFUL_TIMEOUT_S:
                        final = _failed(request_id, "budget_exceeded")
                        break
                    attempt, outcome = await self._attempt(
                        req, request_id, n, min(self._timeout_s, remaining)
                    )
                    attempts.append(attempt)
                    final = outcome
                    if attempt.status in RETRYABLE:
                        if self._breaker is not None:
                            self._breaker.record_failure()
                        raise _Retry
                    if self._breaker is not None:
                        self._breaker.record_success()
        except RetryError:
            final = _failed(request_id, "exhausted")
        return final.model_copy(update={"attempts": tuple(attempts)})

TS = datetime(2026, 11, 25, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)

    base: dict[str, object] = {
        "ts": TS, "event_type": "message.received", "conversation_id": conv, "status": "received",
    }
    base.update(kw)
    return Event.model_validate(base)


@pytest.fixture
def store(tmp_path: Path) -> SqliteEventStore:
    return SqliteEventStore(str(tmp_path / "events.db"))


def test_timeline_in_order_per_conversation(store: SqliteEventStore) -> None:
    store.append(ev(status="received"))
    store.append(ev(conv="outra"))
    store.append(ev(event_type="quote_attempt", status="timeout", latency_ms=3001,

        con.execute("DELETE FROM events")

    assert len(SqliteEventStore(path).timeline("c1")) == 1


def test_redact_processor_removes_raw_pii() -> None:
    out = redact_processor(None, "info", {"event": "x", "payload": {"t": "cpf <CPF>"}})
    assert "529.982" not in json.dumps(out)
    assert "<CPF_1>" in json.dumps(out)


def test_logging_store_writes_json_with_ids(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    from autoseguro_agent.adapters.events_memory import InMemoryEventStore
    from autoseguro_agent.observability import configure_logging

    configure_logging()
    store = LoggingEventStore(InMemoryEventStore())

    data = json.loads(line)
    assert data["event"] == "quote_attempt"
    assert data["conversation_id"] == "c1"
    assert data["quote_request_id"] == "qr_9"
    assert data["status"] == "http_5xx"

"""EventStore em SQLite, append-only garantido por trigger (REQ-41).

Zero setup para o avaliador e inspecionável com um comando:
    sqlite3 autoseguro.db "select seq, event_type, status, latency_ms from events"
Em produção: Postgres com a mesma tabela e as mesmas regras.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import threading

from autoseguro_agent.domain.events import Event

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    ts TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    message_id TEXT,
    quote_request_id TEXT,
    quote_attempt_id TEXT,
    handoff_id TEXT,
    latency_ms INTEGER,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_events_conversation ON events(conversation_id, seq);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_events_wa ON events(json_extract(payload_json, '$.wa_message_id'));
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON events
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'events is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON events
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'events is append-only'); END;
"""

COLUMNS = (
    "ts, event_type, conversation_id, status, message_id, quote_request_id, "
    "quote_attempt_id, handoff_id, latency_ms, payload_json"
)


class SqliteEventStore:
    def __init__(self, path: str) -> None:
        self._con = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False)
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        with self._lock:
            self._con.executescript(SCHEMA)

    def append(self, event: Event) -> None:
        row = (
            event.ts.isoformat(),
            event.event_type,
            event.conversation_id,
            event.status,
            event.message_id,
            event.quote_request_id,
            event.quote_attempt_id,
            event.handoff_id,
            event.latency_ms,
            json.dumps(event.payload, ensure_ascii=False, default=str),
        )
        with self._lock:
            self._con.execute(f"INSERT INTO events ({COLUMNS}) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", row)
            self._con.commit()

    def timeline(self, conversation_id: str) -> list[Event]:
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._con.execute(
                f"SELECT {COLUMNS} FROM events WHERE conversation_id = ? ORDER BY seq",
                (conversation_id,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [
            Event(
                ts=r[0], event_type=r[1], conversation_id=r[2], status=r[3], message_id=r[4],
                quote_request_id=r[5], quote_attempt_id=r[6], handoff_id=r[7], latency_ms=r[8],
                payload=json.loads(r[9]),
            )
            for r in rows
        ]

    def seen_wa_message(self, wa_message_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._con.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE event_type = 'message.received' "
                "AND json_extract(payload_json, '$.wa_message_id') = ? LIMIT 1",
                (wa_message_id,),
            ).fetchone()
        return row is not None

    base: dict[str, object] = {
        "ts": TS, "event_type": "message.received", "conversation_id": conv, "status": "received",
    }
    base.update(kw)
    return Event.model_validate(base)

def store(tmp_path: Path) -> SqliteEventStore:
    return SqliteEventStore(str(tmp_path / "events.db"))

    store.append(ev(status="received"))
    store.append(ev(conv="outra"))
    store.append(ev(event_type="quote_attempt", status="timeout", latency_ms=3001,

    con = sqlite3.connect(tmp_path / "events.db")

        con.execute("DELETE FROM events")

)

"""Composition root: o único lugar que conhece todos os adaptadores (SOLID · D)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from autoseguro_agent.adapters.circuit_breaker import CircuitBreaker
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.clock import SystemClock
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.events_memory import InMemoryEventStore
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.llm_anthropic import AnthropicLLM
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.llm_fake import FakeLLM
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.quote_http import HttpQuoteGateway
from autoseguro_agent.adapters.sqlite_events import SqliteEventStore
from autoseguro_agent.agent import Agent
from autoseguro_agent.graph.nodes import Deps
from autoseguro_agent.observability import LoggingEventStore, configure_logging
from autoseguro_agent.pii import InMemoryVault
from autoseguro_agent.ports import EventStore, LLMClient, OutboundChannel
from autoseguro_agent.settings import Settings


class OutboxChannel:
    """Simula o envio pelo WhatsApp: guarda o que saiu (o webhook devolve na resposta)."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.sent: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    def send(self, conversation_id: str, text: str) -> None:
        self.sent.append((conversation_id, text))


@dataclass
class App:
    agent: Agent
    gateway: HttpQuoteGateway
    events: EventStore
    settings: Settings
    closers: list[Any] = field(default_factory=list)

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        for closer in self.closers:
            await closer()


def make_llm(settings: Settings) -> LLMClient:
    if settings.llm_provider == "fake":
        return FakeLLM()
    key = settings.anthropic_api_key.get_secret_value() if settings.anthropic_api_key else None
    return AnthropicLLM(
        model=settings.llm_model,
        effort=settings.llm_effort,
        timeout_s=settings.llm_timeout_s,
        api_key=key,
    )


def make_gateway(settings: Settings) -> HttpQuoteGateway:
    clock = SystemClock()
    return HttpQuoteGateway(
        settings.quote_base_url,
        timeout_s=settings.quote_timeout_s,
        max_attempts=settings.quote_max_attempts,
        budget_s=settings.quote_budget_s,
        breaker=CircuitBreaker(clock, settings.breaker_failures, settings.breaker_open_s),
        clock=clock,
    )


async def build_app(
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    *,
    outbound: OutboundChannel | None = None,
    persistent: bool = False,
    log_json: bool = False,
) -> App:
    """`persistent=True`: eventos e checkpoint em SQLite (API). Senão, memória (CLI, testes)."""
    settings = settings or Settings()
    gateway = make_gateway(settings)
    await gateway.load_rules()

    store: EventStore
    checkpointer: Any = None
    closers: list[Any] = []
    if persistent:
        import aiosqlite
        from langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite.aio import AsyncSqliteSaver

        store = SqliteEventStore(settings.db_path)
        conn = await aiosqlite.connect(settings.checkpoint_db_path)
        checkpointer = AsyncSqliteSaver(conn)
        await checkpointer.setup()
        closers.append(conn.close)
    else:
        store = InMemoryEventStore()
    if log_json:
        configure_logging()
        store = LoggingEventStore(store)

    deps = Deps(
        llm=make_llm(settings),
        gateway=gateway,
        events=store,
        outbound=outbound or OutboxChannel(),
        clock=SystemClock(),
        vault=InMemoryVault(),
        wait_message_after_s=settings.wait_message_after_s,
    )
    return App(
        agent=Agent(deps, checkpointer),
        gateway=gateway,
        events=store,
        settings=settings,
        closers=closers,
    )

"""Chat no terminal para demo.

    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli                 # Claude (precisa ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli --fake-llm      # sem chave, extrator heurístico
    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli --events        # mostra a linha do tempo de eventos
    uv run python -m autoseguro_agent.cli --script conversa.txt   # uma mensagem por linha

Mensagens começando com [audio], [imagem] ou [documento] simulam mídia.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from autoseguro_agent.agent import MessageType
from autoseguro_agent.bootstrap import build_app
from autoseguro_agent.domain.events import Event
from autoseguro_agent.settings import Settings

MEDIA_PREFIX: dict[str, MessageType] = {
    "[audio]": "audio",
    "[imagem]": "image",
    "[documento]": "document",
}


def format_event(e: Event) -> str:
    ids = " ".join(
        f"{k}={v}"
        for k, v in (
            ("msg", e.message_id),
            ("qr", e.quote_request_id),
            ("qa", e.quote_attempt_id),
            ("ho", e.handoff_id),
        )
        if v
    )
    lat = f" {e.latency_ms}ms" if e.latency_ms is not None else ""
    extra = ""
    if e.event_type == "handoff.opened":
        extra = f" rule={e.payload.get('rule_id')} prio={e.payload.get('priority')}"
    if e.event_type == "quote_attempt":
        extra = f" tentativa={e.payload.get('attempt')} http={e.payload.get('http_status')}"
    return f"    · {e.event_type} [{e.status}]{lat} {ids}{extra}"


async def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    settings = Settings()
    if args.fake_llm:
        settings = settings.model_copy(update={"llm_provider": "fake"})
    if settings.llm_provider == "anthropic" and settings.anthropic_api_key is None:
        print("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY não configurada. Use --fake-llm ou crie agent/.env.")
        return 2

    app = await build_app(settings)
    conv = args.conversation or f"conv_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    print(
        f"conversation_id={conv} · LLM={settings.llm_provider} · regras={app.gateway.rules_source}"
    )
    print("Digite sua mensagem (/sair para encerrar).\n")

    lines = Path(args.script).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if args.script else None
    seen = 0
    while True:
        if lines is not None:
            if not lines:
                break
            text = lines.pop(0).strip()
            if not text:
                continue
            print(f"Lead: {text}")
        else:
            try:
                text = (await asyncio.to_thread(input, "Lead: ")).strip()
            except EOFError:
                break
        if text in {"/sair", "/exit"}:
            break
        mtype: MessageType = next(
            (t for p, t in MEDIA_PREFIX.items() if text.lower().startswith(p)), "text"
        )
        replies = await app.agent.handle(conv, text, message_type=mtype)
        for r in replies:
            print("Agente: " + r.replace("\n", "\n        "))
        if args.events:
            timeline = app.events.timeline(conv)
            for e in timeline[seen:]:
                print(format_event(e))
            seen = len(timeline)
        print()
    return 0


def main() -> None:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Chat com o agente AutoSeguro")
    ap.add_argument("--fake-llm", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--events", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--conversation")
    ap.add_argument("--script")
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(run(ap.parse_args())))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    request_latency_ms: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    turn_seconds: list[float] = field(default_factory=list)

        finished = [e for e in timeline if e.event_type == "quote_request.finished"]
        for e in finished:
            report.request_status[e.status] += 1
            report.request_latency_ms.append(e.latency_ms or 0)
            report.attempts_per_request[int(e.payload.get("attempts", 0))] += 1
            if e.status == "failed":
                report.failure_reasons[str(e.payload.get("failure_reason"))] += 1
        for e in timeline:
            if e.event_type == "quote_attempt":
                report.attempt_status[e.status] += 1
            if e.payload.get("kind") == "waiting":
                report.waiting_messages += 1
        failed = any(e.status == "failed" for e in finished)
        handed = any(e.event_type == "handoff.opened" for e in timeline)
        if failed and not handed:
            report.failed_without_handoff += 1

    await asyncio.gather(*(one(i) for i in range(n)))
    return report


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--url", default="http://localhost:8001")
    ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=50)
    ap.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=10)
    ap.add_argument("--out")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    report = asyncio.run(run_chaos(args.url, args.n, args.concurrency))
    data = report.summary()
    print(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    if args.out:
        with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
            f.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
